# Arbor — Codebase Intelligence & Developer Workbench

> Turn a GitHub repository into an inspectable architecture map, dependency graph, and saved health report. Audits run asynchronously via a background worker or a scheduled daily 03:00 UTC serverless fallback.

## Overview
Arbor helps developers inspect software structure and repository health. Its audits use Babel AST parsing and explicit static checks rather than generative AI. The same source and rule set produce repeatable structural checks; results cover the checks Arbor implements and do not replace code review.

## Key Capabilities
- **Architecture and health audits**: Summarizes repository structure, dependencies, technical debt, performance, security, documentation, and design-system signals.
- **Dependency maps**: Visualizes import relationships between analyzed TypeScript and JavaScript modules and surfaces detected circular dependencies.
- **Language coverage**: Import-graph analysis covers TypeScript and JavaScript. Stack detection also recognizes Python and Go, and Python requirements files are read for dependency data.
- **Evidence-backed findings**: Shows relevant file paths and line locations for supported checks.
- **Secret and environment checks**: Flags patterns that may indicate committed credentials and identifies environment variables not documented in an example file.
- **Interactive API explorer and documentation**: Includes an OpenAPI runner and versioned Markdown documentation hub.
- **README badges**: Generates SVG repository-score badges for public repositories at `/api/badge/{project-id}`. Copy the badge Markdown from the project report.

## Security & Privacy
- **Temporary working copy**: Arbor uses a shallow repository copy during analysis and removes it when processing finishes. Stored reports contain derived results such as scores, structure, dependency relationships, and findings, not complete source files.
- **Core audit does not use AI**: The repository audit uses AST and rule-based checks. Source files are not sent to a generative AI service as part of that audit.
- **Optional AI features**: Off unless a user adds their own OpenAI or Anthropic API key. Finding explanations send finding details to the chosen provider. Patch suggestions send the contents of one selected source file, up to 64 KB, to that provider.
- **GitHub permissions**: GitHub OAuth requests the `read:user`, `user:email`, and `repo` scopes. Review the permissions on GitHub's authorization screen before connecting. You can also analyze public repositories without granting private-repository access.
- **Token security**: Stored OAuth tokens, personal access tokens, and provider keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.
- **Policies**: Privacy Policy at https://arborgit.vercel.app/privacy and Terms of Service at https://arborgit.vercel.app/terms.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Community (Free)**: Up to 10 audits per hour per account across all connected repositories, with dependency maps and README badges for public repositories.
- **Teams (in development, join the waitlist)**: Planned shared workspaces with role-based access, scheduled health sync, and CI checks. No billing integration, launch date, or pricing is live yet.
